faq.title: Common questions.
items: Do I have to connect my bank account?
No. You can simply upload a statement as CSV. A direct connection is optional.
Who is RIDEFF Life for?
For anyone who wants to keep money, time and goals in view without updating spreadsheets every evening. For example shift work, family or studies.
Does the AI make decisions for me?
No. It makes suggestions and shows what they’re based on. Only you cancel, move or save.
How does the AI find career and money opportunities?

From the data you share, such as bank statements, your employment contract or CV. On your own platform it researches what moves you forward in your career and finances, including things you wouldn't have thought of yourself.
Can I brainstorm ideas with the AI?
Yes. In the brainstorming space you think out loud and Life does the maths with your real numbers. You end up with possible paths, not a finished decision.
When does it start?
Right away. Create an account and try it free for 14 days, no payment details. For Life Private, book a short call first.
